sources.title: Instruction Fine-Tuning of Llama 3.1 8B with LoRA
sources.snippet: This tutorial shows how to fine-tune the Llama 3.1 model on AWS Trainium accelerators using optimum-neuron. This is based on the Llama 3.1 fine-tuning example script. 1. 🛠️ Setup AWS Environment We'll use a trn1.32xlarge instance with 16 Trainium Accelerators (32 Neuron Cores) and the Hugging Face Neuron Deep Learning AMI.
